title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a legendary 1970 show with stellar acoustic and electric sets, though marred by occasional cuts and sound glitches.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this May 2 1970 performance, especially the transcendent Cryptical Envelopment → Cosmic Charlie sequence and the unforgettable acoustic set. The sbd source is generally good but listeners note some mistakes, cuts and overall sound issues that prevent it from being a pristine recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight exceptional musical moments; the only drawback is repeated mention of occasional sound glitches, leading to a strong but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers cite mistakes, cuts and general sound issues, but overall the sbd mix is usable and captures the performance well enough for fans.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic set is singled out as a highlight, with the electric sets described as amazing; overall flow praised for balancing folk‑rock intimacy and psychedelic explorations.
